annotations.title: Find the key of a song from its chords

description: Works out the most likely key of a song from its chord progression, gives each chord its Roman numeral, lists the other chords that belong to the key, and suggests which scale to solo with.

chords.description: The chords in order, e.g. "G D Em C" or "Am F C G".
